saab.title: Cleura selected as a strategic cloud partner for Saab

claims.label: Company overview
claims.value: European cloud provider offering fully automated digital infrastructure services for organisations that want to innovate without sacrificing data privacy.
claims.excerpt: Cleura is the European cloud, offering fully automated digital infrastructure services for companies that want to innovate without sacrificing data privacy.

claims.label: Headquartered in Sweden (part of Iver)
claims.value: Part of Iver; headquartered in Sweden.
claims.excerpt: As a part of Iver, Cleura is headquartered in Sweden.

claims.label: Cleura Cloud — OpenStack IaaS
claims.value: Open-source based infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) built on OpenStack, with data hosted in certified European data centres.
claims.excerpt: We provide open-source based infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS), built on OpenStack, with all data hosted in certified European data centers.

claims.label: Compliant Cloud
claims.value: Compliant Cloud: a European cloud platform designed for mission-critical data and applications.
claims.excerpt: A robust European cloud platform for innovation, designed for mission critical data and applications.

claims.label: Public Cloud
claims.value: Public Cloud: build, test and deploy applications with full automation in a European public cloud based on OpenStack.
claims.excerpt: Build, test and deploy your applications with full automation in a European public cloud based on OpenStack.

claims.label: Private Cloud
claims.value: Private Cloud: turnkey solution for enterprises that require their own OpenStack-based cloud.
claims.excerpt: Private Cloud from Cleura is a turnkey solution for enterprises that requires their own OpenStack-based cloud.

claims.label: Compute, containers, storage, databases, managed services, training
claims.value: Compute (virtual machines), containers, storage, databases, managed services and training, delivered with a focus on digital sovereignty.
claims.excerpt: We offer compute (VMs), containers, storage, databases, managed services, and training

claims.label: AI platform & inference services (upcoming)
claims.value: Close to launching an AI platform and inference services on Compliant Cloud, targeting organisations that use AI on sensitive data.
claims.excerpt: Cleura is close to launching an AI platform and inference services for customers and partners.

claims.label: AI on sensitive data
claims.value: The AI services run exclusively within the EU and target organisations that use AI on sensitive data.
claims.excerpt: The services run on Compliant Cloud, which Cleura operates exclusively within the EU. They target organisations that use AI on sensitive data.

claims.label: Planned AI and data marketplace build-out
claims.value: Plans to add compute capacity and a marketplace of building blocks for data and AI development.
claims.excerpt: The AI platform is the first step in a planned build-out. Cleura will add compute capacity and a marketplace of building blocks for data and AI development.

claims.label: Data sovereignty outside US extraterritorial law
claims.value: States that it is not subject to US extraterritorial surveillance laws, supporting European digital sovereignty requirements.
claims.excerpt: Cleura does not depend on an unstable adequacy decision and is not subject to US extraterritorial surveillance laws.

claims.label: ISO 27001:2022, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 certified
claims.value: Certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 27001:2022 (quality, environmental and information security management).
claims.excerpt: Cleura is certified according to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001:2022

claims.label: Multi-region European data centres
claims.value: Cloud runs in multiple European regions including Sweden and Germany, with infrastructure certified for security and compliance.
claims.excerpt: Cleura Cloud runs in multiple European regions, including Sweden and Germany, with all infrastructure certified for security and compliance.

claims.label: OpenStack & open source
claims.value: Heavy engagement in open source with decades of experience building and scaling cloud infrastructure.
claims.excerpt: We engage heavily in open source and have decades of experience in building and globally scaling our cloud infrastructure solutions.

claims.label: Defense, public sector, AI, media, MedTech, cybersecurity
claims.value: Customer industries shown on the website: defense, public sector, AI, media, MedTech and cybersecurity.
claims.excerpt: Defense Public Sector AI Media MedTech Cybersecurity

claims.label: Regulated industries & security companies
claims.value: Serves large security companies, enterprises in heavily regulated industries and tech startups.
claims.excerpt: We serve some of the world's largest security companies, significant enterprises in heavily regulated industries, and tech startups.

claims.label: Strategic cloud partner for Saab (press release)
claims.value: Publicly announced multi-year strategic collaboration with Saab around cloud-based digital infrastructure, including design, implementation and operation of a private cloud.
claims.excerpt: Cleura, the European Cloud, and Saab have entered a strategic collaboration around cloud-based digital infrastructure.

claims.label: Partnership with Nextcloud (press release title)
claims.value: Announced an EU sovereign collaboration suite and strategic partnership with Nextcloud.
claims.excerpt: Cleura announces EU sovereign collaboration suite and strategic partnership with Nextcloud

claims.label: Headquartered in Karlskrona, Sweden
claims.excerpt: the cloud company headquartered in Karlskrona, Sweden
